threats.title: Path grammar traversal
threats.attack: An operation embeds absolute, empty, dot, dot-dot, separator, reserved, or normalization-ambiguous components.
threats.residual_risk: Platform namespace semantics may contain unmodelled aliases.

threats.title: Link or mount substitution race
threats.attack: A local actor substitutes a symlink, hard link, object, or mount between validation and use.
threats.residual_risk: Kernel or filesystem bugs can violate post-open guarantees.

threats.title: Replay or cross-context message
threats.attack: A valid frame or authorization is replayed in another sequence, direction, session, role, transaction, or archive.
threats.residual_risk: Catastrophic entropy failure can undermine unique sessions.

threats.title: Protocol or policy downgrade
threats.attack: A peer or rollback selects an older version, algorithm, schema, or minimum policy with weaker guarantees.
threats.residual_risk: Compromise of signed local policy remains.

threats.title: Hostile peer or compromised operator submits dangerous valid input
threats.trust_boundary: authenticated remote input to local decision
threats.attack: An authenticated actor exploits parser/planner flaws or requests an operation outside its authorized intent.
threats.residual_risk: Shared semantic flaws can affect independently isolated processes.

threats.title: Resource exhaustion
threats.attack: Counts, lengths, queues, retries, sparse extents, or event volume exhaust memory, disk, CPU, or descriptors.
threats.residual_risk: Authorized workload can exceed provisioned capacity and require safe suspension.

threats.title: Key theft or authority confusion
threats.trust_boundary: key store/auth process to other components
threats.attack: A compromised component obtains permanent keys or tricks an authority into signing the wrong context.
threats.residual_risk: Endpoint compromise during authorized signing remains.

threats.title: Journal truncation, alteration, fork, or rollback
threats.attack: An actor or failure removes, changes, reorders, forks, or restores older journal records.
threats.residual_risk: Local rollback of both journal and external checkpoint needs an independent anchor design.

threats.title: Build or release supply-chain substitution
threats.attack: A dependency, action, builder, signer, registry, or distribution point inserts unreviewed code or replaces evidence.
threats.residual_risk: Common compromise of source, builders, and independent verifier remains possible.
